GET /health: liveness, read before any credential exists
GET /blobs/{hash}/fetch: the target of an instance-served blob link, gated by the signature in its query
POST /inbound/{token}: where a sender posts an inbound webhook delivery, gated by the unguessable address
GET /auth/.well-known/oauth-authorizatio: the issuer-suffixed spelling of the same document
GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resourc: RFC 9728 resource metadata, which a bearer challenge points at
POST /auth/confirm: the dialog's answer, which renews a stale browser session
GET /auth/forgot-password: the page that says how to recover a forgotten password
GET /auth/error: the OAuth failure page a redirect lands on
GET /auth/static/pages.css: the stylesheet the console and moment pages load
GET /auth/static/pages.js: the script the console and moment pages load
GET /setup/{step}: the owner's setup steps after claiming
POST /setup/name: same-origin owner form submission that names the instance
GET /auth/owner/types/{id}: owner page describing one item type
GET /auth/owner/export: owner page for export and restore
GET /auth/owner/settings/{group}: owner page for one group of settings
GET /auth/owner/keys/new: owner page for making a key
GET /auth/owner/keys/{id}/copy: where a new key's secret was shown once
GET /auth/owner/apps/{id}: owner page for one connected app
GET /auth/owner/browsers: owner page for the browsers signed in
